entities.summary: Brian McGuire Cashman is an American baseball executive for the New York Yankees of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has served as the general manager and senior vice president of the Yankees since 1998. During Cashman's tenure as general manager, he inherited a core that was built by Gene Michael and Bob Watson, and the Yankees have won seven American League pennants and four World Series championships.
